mapper.select: SELECT CR.ROOM_NO, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.CREATED_BY_EMP_NO AS create_by_emp_no, CR.CREATE_DATE, CR.STATUS, LM.CHAT_CONTENT AS LAST_MESSAGE_CONTENT, LM.SEND_DATE AS LAST_MESSAGE_TIME, MC.MEMBER_COUNT, /* CASE 문: roomType이 'P'이면 상대방 이름, 'G'이면 방 이름 */ CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'P' THEN OTH_EMP.EMP_NAME ELSE CR.ROOM_NAME END AS ROOM_NAME, /* CASE 문: roomType이 'P'이면 상대방 프로필 경로, 'G'이면 NULL */ CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'P' THEN OTH_EMP.PROFILE_IMG_PATH ELSE NULL END AS CHAT_USER_IMG_PATH, /* 안 읽은 메시지 수 계산 로직 */ ( SELECT COUNT(CM_UNREAD.MESSAGE_NO) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM_UNREAD WHERE CM_UNREAD.ROOM_NO = CR.ROOM_NO AND CM_UNREAD.MESSAGE_NO > ( SELECT NVL(CRM_LAST_READ.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_NO, 0) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM_LAST_READ WHERE CRM_LAST_READ.ROOM_NO = CR.ROOM_NO AND CRM_LAST_READ.EMP_NO = #{empNo} ) AND CM_UNREAD.SENDER_EMP_NO != #{empNo} ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM CR JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM_ME ON CR.ROOM_NO = CRM_ME.ROOM_NO AND CRM_ME.EMP_NO = #{empNo} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_NO, CHAT_CONTENT, SEND_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ROOM_NO ORDER BY SEND_DATE DESC) as RN FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ) LM ON CR.ROOM_NO = LM.ROOM_NO AND LM.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_NO, COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY ROOM_NO ) MC ON CR.ROOM_NO = MC.ROOM_NO LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM_OTHER ON CR.ROOM_NO = CRM_OTHER.ROOM_NO AND CRM_OTHER.EMP_NO != #{empNo} AND CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'P' LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE OTH_EMP ON CRM_OTHER.EMP_NO = OTH_EMP.EMP_NO AND CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'P' WHERE CR.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY LM.SEND_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, CR.CREATE_DATE DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND STATUS = 'Y' -- (선택) 현재 활성 상태인 멤버만 확인할 경우
SELECT ROOM_NO, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_TYPE, CREATED_BY_EMP_NO, CREATE_DATE, STATUS FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT m.MESSAGE_NO, m.ROOM_NO, m.SENDER_EMP_NO, e.EMP_NAME as SENDER_NAME, -- 보낸사람 이름 e.PROFILE_IMG_PATH as SENDER_PROFILE_IMG_PATH, -- 보낸사람 프로필 경로 m.CHAT_CONTENT, m.MESSAGE_TYPE, m.SEND_DATE, m.STATUS FROM CHAT_MESSAGE m JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON m.SENDER_EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO WHERE m.ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} AND m.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY m.SEND_DATE ASC

INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER ( MEMBER_NO, ROOM_NO, EMP_NO, JOIN_DATE, IS_ADMIN, -- 방장 여부 STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{roomNo}, #{empNo}, SYSDATE, #{isAdmin, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT CR.ROOM_NO, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.CREATED_BY_EMP_NO, CR.CREATE_DATE, CR.STATUS FROM CHAT_ROOM CR JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM1 ON CR.ROOM_NO = CRM1.ROOM_NO JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM2 ON CR.ROOM_NO = CRM2.ROOM_NO WHERE CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'P' AND CR.STATUS = 'Y' AND CRM1.EMP_NO = #{emp1} AND CRM2.EMP_NO = #{emp2} AND CRM1.STATUS = 'Y' -- 활성 상태인 멤버만 고려 AND CRM2.STATUS = 'Y' -- 활성 상태인 멤버만 고려 AND CRM1.EMP_NO != CRM2.EMP_NO -- 두 멤버가 다른지 확인

FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} -- Map에서 "roomNo" 키 값을 참조 ) WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} -- Map에서 "roomNo" 키 값을 참조 AND EMP_NO = #{userEmpNo} -- Map에서 "userEmpNo" 키 값을 참조
